CustomField.description: Picklist (Edit, Update, Change) supplying the Edit action's button text for Repeater and Table sections. Passed as edit-button-label to c-flow-form-repeat / c-flow-data-table. Only takes effect when Enable Edit Action is checked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose the wording for the edit-row button, such as Edit, Update, or Change. Requires Enable Edit Action to be on.
CustomField.label: Edit Button Label
